evidence_summary: Inconsistent behavior: vector with 3 dimensions (collection expects 4) was incorrectly accepted with HTTP 200 on REQ 3, but correctly rejected with HTTP 400 and 'Vector dimension error: expected dim: 4, got 3' on REQ 5 (same input with ?wait=true parameter)
rationale: Mixed FAILED+PASSED pattern on same endpoint: the same invalid input (3-dim vector for 4-dim collection) was incorrectly accepted without the wait parameter but correctly rejected with the wait parameter, indicating intermittent enforcement of dimension validation
